Hi, I'm Désiré.

I'm a Data Science engineering student at Télécom Paris, pursuing a double degree with INPT.

I'm curious about how things work, especially where mathematics, research, and engineering come together. I enjoy digging into ideas, understanding the theory behind them, and experimenting to see how they hold up in practice.

Much of my work revolves around artificial intelligence, but my interests aren't limited to it. I like learning new things, building projects, and exploring questions that catch my attention.

This blog is my space to share what I learn, document my experiments, and write about ideas I find worth exploring.
